arguments.code:
import math
# Compose newline-separated wish list items with total price = round(price*quantity)
items_lines = []
for item in wish_list:
    name = item.get('product_name')
    qty = item.get('quantity')
    price = item.get('price')
    total = price * qty
    total_rounded = int(round(total))
    items_lines.append(f"{name} => ${total_rounded}")
message = "\n".join(items_lines)
print('husband_phone_number', husband_contacts[0].get('phone_number') if husband_contacts else None)
print('message_preview')
print(message)

# Send text message to husband
send_res = apis.phone.send_text_message(phone_number=husband_contacts[0].get('phone_number'), message=message, access_token=phone_token)
print('send_res', send_res)
